raw_snippet: In 2025, Loop acquired StrategIQ Commerce, bringing together shipment visibility and freight audit and pay under one AI-native platform.
value_text: acquired StrategIQ Commerce (shipment visibility and freight/parcel audit provider, USA)
note: Whole-company sale to Loop Payments, Inc.; terms undisclosed. Date: Only the month is known: completed October 2025 per StrategIQ's adviser Mesirow (release of 25 June 2026); Loop's page says only '2025'
